question: If each of the letters in the word CONAGE is arranged in the English alphabetical order, then how many letters are there in the English alphabetical series between the letter which is fourth from the left and the one which is fourth from the right in the new letter-cluster thus formed?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9c862ea9c33a633c54bfcf4c329c66d9a52118504f28cbfbfdf760e12f52cc05.png] 

The logic followed here is:

If each of the letters in the word CONAGE is arranged in the English alphabetical order,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d141ca807014878ef38382777ac24766c065e6273078968f6826f039193c54cb.png] 

The fourth letter from the left end = G

And, the fourth from the right = E

Then **One **letter (E, __**F,**__ G) is there in the English alphabetical series between the letter which is fourth from the left and the one which is fourth from the right in the new letter-cluster thus formed.

Hence, the correct answer is "One".
